test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar-graph given below shows the distribution of the expenditure of the Company ABC under different heads during a given year as percentages of the total expenditure of the company during that year. The total annual expenditure of the company is ₹ 30 crores.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/385769727f8507bc604e74a3e6b67c0dab07dde63fe216f36c3c061209fd7c94.png] 

What is the difference (in ₹) between the amount spent on rent and that on other expenses?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The amounts spent on rent = 30 × 16%

⇒ 4.8 crore

The amounts spent on other expenses = 30 × 14%

⇒ 4.2 crore

Difference = 4.8 - 4.2

⇒ 0.6 crore

**∴ The required answer is 0.6 crore.**
